notes:
- New: OpenEXR opens, passes and all. The beauty layer across Blender, V-Ray and Arnold naming, values above 1.0 kept as headroom, the Z or mist pass as the depth map, Cryptomatte objects and materials as masks, the alpha as a matte, and the normals pass driving Depth Lighting. Multi-part files list every part's passes.
- New: Finish picture layers take an Object mask, a toggle beside the Depth mask shown only for an OpenEXR, masking the layer by the objects the file names.
- New: Finish layers export. A picture layer's Export tick writes the layer with every export, packed into the one EXR or written as sibling TIFFs, and the graph's Export Layer node writes what any wire carries. Output gains an alpha port.
- New: Layers from File reads a layered OpenEXR or a multi-page TIFF into the Finish stack as image layers, referenced in place. A multi-page TIFF is a first-class source in the File node.
- New: TIFF export keeps 16-bit alpha, and 32-bit float TIFF joins the formats, the scene-linear numbers as they are.
- New: Color Checker calibrates the camera from a photographed reference chart: white balance, exposure and a 3x3 matrix fitted to the published values, a report with the worst patches first, calibrations that save and travel, and a chart editor for custom charts.
- New: Preferences > Interface > Adjustment sections lists every section the Adjustments panel can show, with an eye to hide it and a pin for the pinned group, and a Reset that brings every section back.
- New: The Depth Map sits at one fixed seat in the graph and is computed from whatever is wired into it, so a tonal edit in front of it changes the map; every depth tool reads the plane by a visible wire.
- New: An older catalog is held at a gate until you choose Back Up and Update, Update Without Backup, or Quit; nothing migrates before you answer, and the prompt shows at once.
- New: Catalog backups are verified and journal-complete, a clean quit leaves no journal beside the catalog, and Restore catalog from copy puts a backup in place the safe way, the previous file renamed with the date, never deleted.
- New: Thumbnails are made on demand as cells scroll into view, so a folder of a thousand costs a screen's worth of decodes and the app keeps answering.
- New: Depth Lighting's light kinds are pictures, a sun for a directional light and a lamp for a point light, and a directional light only adds: raising its Strength no longer darkens the far frame.
- New: The Color Checker section is laid out as the work goes, and where the fit's white balance lands is a named two-way choice.
- Fixed: An HDR stack renders like the middle exposure of its bracket, whichever frame sorts first. A bracket whose long exposure sorted first merged about two stops too bright.
- Fixed: Stack and Panorama name their file past any catalog row still holding an earlier one, gone or in the trash; a stack used to fail with a constraint error and need retries.
- Fixed: An OpenEXR opens with the Tone Profile off, the way a JPEG does, so a render no longer opens over a stop bright, and a saved JPEG, TIFF or EXR graph catches up to the same rule.
- Fixed: OpenEXR thumbnails draw, the preview is the file's own beauty, and a large render no longer falls back to the system decoder's dark, contoured picture.
- Fixed: OpenEXR alpha follows the convention, premultiplied in the file and straight inside Heeler, so transparent edges read at their true colour and a Heeler file merges without a halo in Nuke or Blender.
- Fixed: An OpenEXR whose beauty is black opens on its first lit layer, and a passes-only file opens on its Cryptomatte preview.
- Fixed: Depth Lighting on a depth pass from the file shades the exact plane: no ring outside a silhouette, no fringe along an edge.
- Fixed: A Color Checker calibration made in an earlier build renders as it measured; a saved fit is re-expressed for the graph's order on load, nothing to recalibrate.
- Fixed: A saved wire from Depth Map or a File node that does not say which output it takes is marked in the graph, dashed with a note, rather than read silently as the image.
- Fixed: A DNG whose photograph cannot be decoded is refused in words or shown from its embedded preview, never as its thumbnail with raw colour on top.
- Fixed: EXR export writes ZIP-compressed scanlines at half the size, names its depth so it reads back as farness, and refuses a bad layer name by name instead of failing inside the export.
- Fixed: Dropping a pipe on a card's mask or alpha diamond connects, and a field node dropped on a mask wire splices into it like the image chain.
- Fixed: The depth mask's Levels widget follows the panel's width, and the Recolor eyedropper keeps working after switching to a Depth row.
- Fixed: The installers show the EULA as text rather than its Markdown source.
